body: seed husks cling to the duct tape, while bleach marks the empty garden sprayer. road mud joins the two in one tied bundle.
title: Duct tape with the second residue
gloss: Farm residue and response markings share one deliberately ambiguous bundle.
rival_reading: The farm program and the emergency response each explain one layer of the bundle, and the shared knot does not establish which purpose came first.

body: The seed bag is folded shut around the shovel handle. A straight line of dark soil runs from the blade to the bag's seam, but the shovel has no soil on its grip.
title: The seed bag holds a narrow trench
gloss: Seed stock and a freshly used tool were wrapped together.
rival_reading: A response crew could move seed stock and tools while clearing a farm; the clean grip could come from ordinary handling.
